tools.description: Search the BuyWhere product catalog by keyword. Returns a results array where each item has: id, title, price ({amount, currency}), normalized_price_usd, merchant, url, image_url, region, country_code, click_url, affiliate_redirect_url, and updated_at. Covers e-commerce platforms across Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam, and US. Use compact=true for agent-optimized responses adding structured_specs, comparison_attributes, and normalized_price_usd fields.

category.description: Filter by product category name (e.g. "Laptops", "Smartphones", "Televisions"). Use to exclude accessories and get actual products.

compact.description: Return agent-optimized compact shape: structured_specs, comparison_attributes, normalized_price_usd. Reduces response size ~40%. Recommended for agent tool-use.

country_code.description: Filter by ISO country code. Also infers default currency for price filters (SG→SGD, US→USD, VN→VND, TH→THB, MY→MYR).

deliver_to.description: Buyer delivery country/market. Preferred over country_code/country when known.

domain.description: Filter by merchant platform (e.g. lazada, shopee, amazon)

max_price.description: Maximum price (in currency inferred from country_code, or SGD by default)

min_price.description: Minimum price (in currency inferred from country_code, or SGD by default)

mode.description: Search mode: keyword=FTS only, semantic=vector only, hybrid=RRF blend of FTS+vector (default). Falls back to keyword if vector DB or GEMINI_API_KEY unavailable.

query.description: Alias for q (accepted for agent convenience; use q)

region.description: Filter by region (sea, us, eu, au)

tools.name: search_products

tools.description: Get a specific product by its ID, including full details and current price. Provide country_code/deliver_to to verify the product belongs to the requested market.

country_code.description: Country to validate the product against. Alias: country.

deliver_to.description: Buyer delivery country/market. Preferred over country_code/country when known.

tools.name: get_product

tools.description: Compare multiple products side-by-side. Returns price, brand, rating, and category for each.

ids.description: Array of product IDs to compare (2-10)

tools.name: compare_products

tools.description: Get discounted products sorted by discount percentage. Returns a results array where each item has: id, title, price ({amount, currency}), normalized_price_usd, merchant, url, image_url, region, country_code, click_url, and updated_at. Also includes original_price and discount_pct when available. Covers Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam, and US e-commerce. Supports currency, region (sea, us, eu, au) and country (SG, US, VN, MY, ...) filters.

country_code.description: Filter by ISO country code. Alias: country.

currency.description: Filter by currency code (SGD, USD, MYR, VND, THB). Defaults to SGD.

deliver_to.description: Buyer delivery country/market. Preferred over country_code/country when known.

region.description: Filter by region (sea, us, eu, au)

tools.name: get_deals

tools.description: List top-level product categories available in the BuyWhere catalog.

country_code.description: Filter by ISO country code. Defaults to SG.

deliver_to.description: Buyer delivery country/market. Preferred over country_code/country when known.

region.description: Alias for country_code/market (us→US, sg→SG, my→MY, gb→GB, in→IN, au→AU).

tools.name: list_categories

tools.description: Use this whenever a user asks about prices, wants to find the cheapest option, or asks "what's the best price for X" or "where can I buy X for the lowest price". Returns a results array where each item has: id, title, price ({amount, currency}), normalized_price_usd, merchant, url, image_url, region, country_code, click_url, and updated_at. Results are from across all merchants. Also includes structured_specs and comparison_attributes when available.

country_code.description: Country to search in (defaults to SG). Alias: country.

deliver_to.description: Buyer delivery country/market. Preferred over country_code/country when known.

product_name.description: Product name to find best price for (e.g., "iphone 15 pro 256gb", "samsung galaxy s24")

region.description: Region filter - use "us" for United States or "sea" for Southeast Asia

tools.name: find_best_price

tools.description: Find products similar to a given product using vector similarity. Returns up to 10 nearest neighbours by semantic meaning (title+description embedding). Useful for "more like this" recommendations. Accepts product_id directly, or product_name for automatic lookup.

country_code.description: Country to scope product_name lookup (defaults to SG)

limit.description: Number of similar products to return (1-10, default 10)

product_id.description: Catalog product id (products.id; mutually exclusive with product_name). For legacy vector rows, an exact SKU is also accepted.

product_name.description: Product name to find similar items for (auto-resolves to best-matching product ID). Preferred when agent starts with a name/query.

tools.name: find_similar

tools.description: Ingest (upsert) a batch of products into the BuyWhere catalog. Use this to add or update product listings from any merchant/source. Requires a valid API key with ingest permissions. Accepts up to 1000 products per call with source, SKU, title, price, URL, and optional metadata.

products.description: Array of product objects to ingest (max 1000)

is_active.description: Whether the product is active (default: true)

is_available.description: Whether the product is in stock

url.description: Product URL on the merchant site

tools.name: ingest_products
